query: Review acme/sdk#88, which someone else wrote, and leave your feedback as review comments. Your findings: `sdk/config.py` line 41 hardcodes a timeout of 30; `sdk/client.py` line 12 swallows exceptions with a bare `except:`; `sdk/client.py` line 77 has a typo in a log message ('recieved'); and the PR adds no tests and has an empty description.
expected_behavior: Posts the config.py line 41, client.py line 12, and client.py line 77 findings as three separate line-anchored comments, one point each
Does not fold the three line-level findings into one PR-level comment or one multi-point review body
Uses the line-anchored tool for the mode (add_pr_review_comment when staging, gh api .../pulls/88/comments when posting directly), with path and line set for each
Puts only the cross-cutting points (no tests, empty description) in a PR-level comment, not anchored to a line
If the PR-level comment carries both cross-cutting points, gives each its own labeled bullet or short heading instead of a run of paragraphs
Each comment carries a plain-text conventional label and ends with <!--:robot:--> as the last line
